methodology.raw_score: Sum of official live player points × FPL multiplier.
methodology.live_score: Raw score minus transfer hit cost; this net score drives live rank.
methodology.live_overall: Official total minus official GW total, plus calculated live GW score.
methodology.damage_per_point: League-average multiplier minus your multiplier, floored at zero.
methodology.remaining: Active picks whose club fixture is live, upcoming or awaiting status; multipliers follow the official revealed squad.
methodology.fixture_context: Each tracked player carries their live or next GW fixture, kickoff, opponent, minutes, GW points and realised EO-adjusted impact.
